# dtcloud_project_quotas (Data Source)

Reports what a project is using against what it is allowed.

This is the console's summary view: a handful of headline figures with usage and quota side by side.
For every limit the platform tracks, use `dtcloud_project_limits`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dtcloud_projects" "all" {}

# Usage against allowance, as the console shows it.
data "dtcloud_project_quotas" "current" {
  project_id = data.dtcloud_projects.all.active_project_id
}

output "cpu" {
  value = "${data.dtcloud_project_quotas.current.cpu[0].usage} of ${data.dtcloud_project_quotas.current.cpu[0].quota}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String) ID of the project, from dtcloud_projects.

### Optional

- `region_id` (String) Region to report on. Defaults to the provider's configured region.

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (List of Object) vCPU cores. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cpu))
- `floating_ips` (List of Object) Floating IP addresses. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--floating_ips))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `ram` (List of Object) Memory in GiB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ram))
- `storage_space` (List of Object) Storage usage per volume type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--storage_space))
- `vm_status` (List of Object) The project's VMs counted by state. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vm_status))

## Behaviour worth knowing

~> **A `quota` of `-1` means unlimited.** It is passed through rather than translated, so that
arithmetic on it stays honest; check for it before dividing.

* **`in_progress` counts machines with a pending task**, whatever their nominal status. A machine in
  the middle of a resize is counted there rather than under `running` or `stopped`.
* **The region is part of the request path** for this endpoint, unlike every other call in the
  provider. That is why `region_id` is an argument here; it falls back to the provider's region.
